```artifact
Feature: Self-Test

  Scenario: Pre-test mode
    Given the controller is in pre-test mode
    When the user selects the pre-test mode
    Then the GUI displays the pre-test mode menu

  Scenario: Flow sensor accuracy
    Given the blower speed is set to 50% as specified
    And the air lines are open
    And nothing is connected to the output
    When the self-test is run
    Then the flow rate is 5.0 liters per minute as specified
    And the flow rate tolerance range is 0.0 - 1.0 liters per minute as specified

  Scenario: Pressure sensor accuracy
    Given the blower speed is set to 50% as specified
    And the air lines are open
    And nothing is connected to the output
    When the self-test is run
    Then the pressure reading is 1013 mbar as specified

  Scenario Outline: Flow sensor accuracy with different blower speeds
    Given the blower speed is set to <blower_speed>%
    And the air lines are open
    And nothing is connected to the output
    When the self-test is run
    Then the flow rate is <flow_rate> liters per minute as specified
    Examples:
      | blower_speed | flow_rate |
      | 0%           | 0.0        |
      | 25%          | 1.25       |
      | 50%          | 2.5        |
      | 75%          | 3.75       |
      | 100%         | 5.0        |

  Scenario Outline: Pressure sensor accuracy with different blower speeds
    Given the blower speed is set to <blower_speed>%
    And the air lines are open
    And nothing is connected to the output
    When the self-test is run
    Then the pressure reading is <pressure_reading> mbar as specified
    Examples:
      | blower_speed | pressure_reading |
      | 0%           | 1013            |
      | 25%          | 1013.75         |
      | 50%          | 1026.5          |
      | 75%          | 1039.25         |
      | 100%         | 1052.0          |

  Scenario: GUI verification
    Given the controller is in pre-test mode
    When the user selects the pre-test mode
    Then the GUI displays the pre-test mode menu
    And the error message formatting and placement are correct

  Scenario: Negative tests
    Given the blower speed is set to 50% as specified
    And the air lines are closed
    When the self-test is run
    Then the self-test fails due to air line error
    Given the blower speed is set to 50% as specified
    And nothing is connected to the output
    When the self-test is run
    Then the self-test fails due to no output connected error
    Given the blower speed is set to 50% as specified
    And the air lines are open
    And the output is connected to a device
    When the self-test is run
    Then the self-test fails due to device connected error

  Scenario: Timing and performance checks
    Given the controller is in pre-test mode
    When the user selects the pre-test mode
    Then the self-test completes within 10 seconds
    And the response time is less than 1 second
```
